# Step 1: Fetch all songs in Spotify song library (paginated)

def fetch_all_song_library(access_token, page_limit=20):
    all_songs = []
    page_index = 0
    while True:
        page = apis.spotify.show_song_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        if not page:
            break
        all_songs.extend(page)
        page_index += 1
    return all_songs

if 'spotify_token' not in globals() or not spotify_token:
    spotify_token = apis.spotify.login(username='ch-burch@gmail.com', password='99W1c[K')['access_token']

songs_library = fetch_all_song_library(access_token=spotify_token, page_limit=20)
print('library_songs_count', len(songs_library))
print('first_5_song_ids', [s['song_id'] for s in songs_library[:5]])
print('last_5_song_ids', [s['song_id'] for s in songs_library[-5:]])

def fetch_all_playlists(access_token, page_limit=20):
    all_playlists = []
    page_index = 0
    while True:
        page = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        if not page:
            break
        all_playlists.extend(page)
        page_index += 1
    return all_playlists

playlists_library = fetch_all_playlists(spotify_token, page_limit=20)
print('playlists_count', len(playlists_library))
print('first_playlists', [(p['playlist_id'], p.get('title'), len(p.get('song_ids',[]))) for p in playlists_library[:5]])
print('last_playlists', [(p['playlist_id'], p.get('title'), len(p.get('song_ids',[]))) for p in playlists_library[-5:]])

unique_playlist_song_ids = set()
for p in playlists_library:
    for sid in p.get('song_ids', []):
        unique_playlist_song_ids.add(sid)

print('unique_song_ids_in_playlists', len(unique_playlist_song_ids))
print('unique_song_ids_in_playlists_sample', list(unique_playlist_song_ids)[:20])

# <playbook_cite>Following entry [TOKEN / LOGIN MANAGEMENT] and [Strategies And Hard Rules]: reading required data then acting only on computed subsets</playbook_cite>
# <uncertainty>Not sure if any songs might have missing release_date; will treat missing as not eligible.</uncertainty>

# Use spotify_token, songs_library, playlists_library, and unique_playlist_song_ids already fetched.

all_candidate_song_ids = set([s['song_id'] for s in songs_library]) | unique_playlist_song_ids
print('candidate_song_ids_count', len(all_candidate_song_ids))

release_date_by_song_id = {}
for sid in sorted(all_candidate_song_ids):
    sg = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    release_date_by_song_id[sid] = sg.get('release_date')

# Print a few samples
sample_ids = sorted(all_candidate_song_ids)[:10]
print('sample_release_dates', {sid: release_date_by_song_id[sid] for sid in sample_ids})

# Compute eligible songs: release year < 2021
eligible_song_ids = set()
missing_release = []
for sid, rd in release_date_by_song_id.items():
    if not rd:
        missing_release.append(sid)
        continue
    year = int(rd[:4])
    if year < 2021:
        eligible_song_ids.add(sid)

print('eligible_song_ids_count', len(eligible_song_ids))
print('missing_release_date_count', len(missing_release))
print('missing_release_date_sample', missing_release[:10])

# <playbook_cite>Following entry [Strategies And Hard Rules]: reading required data then acting only on computed subsets</playbook_cite>
# <uncertainty>Not sure whether each eligible song exists in every playlist where its id appears; will rely on playlist 'song_ids' membership from show_playlist_library.</uncertainty>

library_song_ids = set(s['song_id'] for s in songs_library)
eligible_in_library = eligible_song_ids & library_song_ids
eligible_not_in_library = eligible_song_ids - eligible_in_library

print('library_songs_count', len(library_song_ids))
print('eligible_song_ids_count', len(eligible_song_ids))
print('eligible_in_library_count', len(eligible_in_library))
print('eligible_not_in_library_count', len(eligible_not_in_library))
print('eligible_in_library_song_ids', sorted(eligible_in_library))

# Remove from song library
library_remove_results = []
for sid in sorted(eligible_in_library):
    res = apis.spotify.remove_song_from_library(song_id=sid, access_token=spotify_token)
    library_remove_results.append((sid, res))

print('library_remove_success_count', sum(1 for _,r in library_remove_results if r and 'message' in r))
print('library_remove_messages_sample', library_remove_results[:3])

# Remove from playlists
playlist_remove_count = 0
playlist_remove_results = []
for p in playlists_library:
    pid = p['playlist_id']
    for sid in p.get('song_ids', []):
        if sid in eligible_song_ids:
            res = apis.spotify.remove_song_from_playlist(playlist_id=pid, song_id=sid, access_token=spotify_token)
            playlist_remove_count += 1
            playlist_remove_results.append((pid, sid, res))

print('playlist_remove_operations_count', playlist_remove_count)
print('playlist_remove_results_sample', playlist_remove_results[:5])
